title: API Tokens

gateway.title: Inference tokens
gateway.description: For applications calling deployed models (/v1, OpenAI-compatible); they start with gw-. They cannot call the platform management API.

platform.title: Platform API tokens
platform.description: Call the platform management API without signing in, and connect to the MCP service; they start with gwp_. A token acts as you, with your current permissions, narrowed by its scope: a read token can only read; a read-write token can do what you can in the console. Tokens are created and revoked from a signed-in session only.
platform.scopeHelp: MCP needs read only. A read-write token can change the platform; give one only to programs that need it.
platform.revokeConfirm: Revoke “{{name}}”? Programs using it lose access at once.
platform.nameTooLong: Name must not exceed 128 UTF-8 bytes (Chinese characters usually use 3 bytes each)
